Write/overwrite file in the cache

Source: R/cache.R
write_to_cache.Rd

Write/overwrite file in the cache

Usage

write_to_cache(x, cache)

Arguments

x

the object to write/overwrite in the cache, using the file path generated by construct_cache_file_path()

cache

One of "use", "ignore", "overwrite". If cache = 'use', x is saved to the cache so long as it doesn't already exist there. If cache = 'overwrite', x is saved to the cache, overwriting an existing object if one exists. If cache = 'ignore', nothing is done.

Value

Saves an .rds file to the cache depending

Examples

df <- data.frame(x = 1:10)
temp_fun <- function(x = 1, y = 2, z = 3, cache){product = x*y*z; write_to_cache(x = product, cache = cache)}
temp_fun(cache = "use")
#> Error in write_to_cache(x = product, cache = cache): could not find function "write_to_cache"
temp_fun(cache = "ignore")
#> Error in write_to_cache(x = product, cache = cache): could not find function "write_to_cache"
temp_fun(cache = "overwrite")
#> Error in write_to_cache(x = product, cache = cache): could not find function "write_to_cache"
rm(test_fun)
#> Warning: object 'test_fun' not found
